# Copilot Instructions
- **Workspace Focus**: `polygon-mev-bot/` holds the active codebase (contracts in `contracts/`, Nebula tooling in `scripts/`, Eliza agent in `eliza-agent-ai/`, local MCP server under `mcp-servers/`). Ignore marketing docs that claim completion until verified.
- **Reality Check Summary**: Generator + agent exist, but only `MEVExecutor.sol` and `Interfaces.sol` are present in `contracts/src/generated/`; adapters, OracleLib, and full MEVExecutor features (JIT, liquidations, Kelly sizing) are missing. MCP bridge is stubbed, RL model absent, docs overstate readiness.
- **Verification Matrix**: Track progress item-by-item (see checklist below). Each row is ✅ when the file exists, is fully implemented, integrated, and tested: `generate-contracts-with-nebula.ts`, `thirdweb-nebula-integration.ts`, `mcp-config.json`, `package.json`, `MEVExecutor.sol`, `DEXAdapter.sol`, `AaveAdapter.sol`, `JITAdapter.sol`, `OracleLib.sol`, `Interfaces.sol`, documentation set, `GENERATE_NOW.sh`, `forge build`, `forge test -vv`, deployment scripts, `npm start`, credentials, contract imports, TODO scan, end-to-end demo.

Add generation smoke-tests that fail when fewer than six artifacts land in `contracts/src/generated/`.
- **Testing & Deployment**: After regenerating contracts, enforce `forge build` and `forge test -vv` (extend tests to cover every strategy & adapter). Update `contracts/script/Deploy*.s.sol` to deploy the full suite and document verification (`forge script ... --verify`).

- **Agent Execution Pipeline**: Wire Nebula responses into `analyzeOpportunity`, `selectStrategy`, and `executeMEV`. Ensure DRY_RUN/ALLOW_EXECUTION gates remain, but real executions must call Nebula, simulate transactions, and handle on-chain responses. Ship `models/ppo_agent.onnx` or provide download logic so RL recommendations stop defaulting to heuristics.
- **Environment & Secrets**: Provide an authoritative `.env.example` aligned with required keys (`THIRDWEB_SECRET_KEY`, `THIRDWEB_CLIENT_ID`, `PRIVATE_KEY`, Polygon RPC/WSS, LLM keys, Tenderly optional). Docs must no longer claim “credentials preconfigured.”
- **Documentation Cleanup**: Audit the 26 marketing docs; keep only accurate guides. Update `docs/QUICK_START.md`, `MASTER_GUIDE.md`, `WHAT_TO_RUN.txt` to match the real workflow (generation gaps, additional build/test steps, MCP setup, RL model acquisition).
- **Final Verification Run**: When all checklist rows are ✅, execute the full pipeline (generate → build → test → deploy to testnet/mainnet → agent `npm start` with DRY_RUN then live). Capture logs, tx hashes, and performance metrics to substantiate 400 ms latency claims before updating status docs.
